derivation: from a compound of G4012 (περί) and G2508 (καθαίρω);
def: something cleaned off all around, i.e. refuse (figuratively)

occurrences.text: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.
